label: Dickmilch
comment: Soured milks of their own, each made with its own culture of lactococci beside soured milk, not from it (see KINDS).

about.text: German soured milk that has set thick enough to spoon, made from milk with mesophilic lactic cultures and not heated after fermentation. The standard variety has at least 3.5 % fat.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: Set or thick, smooth; little or no whey
Industrial versions use mesophilic Lactococcus lactis at about 22–28 °C and hold the milk at 25–28 °C for 15–20 hours until it sets; rennet can speed this
Northern Germany eats it with sugar and crumbled rye bread or zwieback; it is served with cinnamon and sugar in midsummer or with fried potatoes; Austria and Bavaria use it in soups
